title: Missing moeb tool: Read (start_run result file)
description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) to read the oversized start_run output saved to an absolute host path (C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\...\mcp-moeb-start_run-*.txt). The moeb read_file tool only reads relative paths from the project working directory and cannot access this path.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to return large content via a moeb-accessible relative path (e.g. .moeb/tmp/<run_id>-run-prompt.txt), or add a moeb tool for reading kernel-generated output files by run_id.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
